about: Lays an application out: bars across the top and the bottom, and a body between them with a panel on either side of the page.

divided.about: A hairline on the inner edge of each bar and each panel, and a shell without them.
divided.title: Divided

scroll.about: The main region scrolling inside a shell the height of the window, and the window scrolling under sticky bars.
scroll.title: Scroll

title: App shell

variant.about: The three looks. `plain` puts every region on the page ground. `inset` gives the main region the panel ground, a hairline and a shadow over a muted root, and `floating` gives each panel's content the same instead.
variant.title: Looks
